QUESTIONS

Before you call.

Questions before you call? Start here.

All questions & answers
What information should I have ready?+

Share your exact pickup location, a callback number, the vehicle make and model, what happened, and the destination you have in mind. Mention an RV, all-wheel drive, damage, or restricted access when you call.

Are you available at night?+

Square State Towing advertises 24-hour emergency towing. Call to discuss current availability and an arrival estimate for your location.

What affects the cost of a tow?+

Vehicle type, condition, pickup access, distance, and the work required can affect a quote. Ask for the total charge and any additional fees before agreeing to service.

Can you tow an all-wheel-drive vehicle?+

Tell the operator your vehicle’s exact drivetrain. Suitable equipment and the manufacturer’s requirements need to be considered before transport is arranged.
